_about: The Historical kit: pieces rebuilt from historical reference images, as detailing meshes for the greybox. Grouped by category and type, which are also the folders: reference images in _builder/images/sheets/historical/<Category>/<Type>/<id>.png (the site shows only these), work files in _Docs/Kit/Historical/<Category>/<Type>/, FBX in _Docs/Kit/FBX/Historical/<Category>/<Type>/. Mesh name SM_HI_<Type>_<Descriptor>_<NN>, image id HI-<Type>_<Descriptor>_<NN>. method: blender-fretwork, blender-lathe, blender-sweep, blender-modelled or meshy.

intro: Sawn and carved brackets under eaves, balconies and jetties.
Gesägte und geschnitzte Konsolen unter Traufen, Balkonen und Vorkragungen.
Turned and carved balusters for stairs, galleries and balconies.
Gedrechselte und geschnitzte Baluster für Treppen, Galerien und Balkone.
Forged weather vanes for roof points, gables and towers.
Geschmiedete Wetterfahnen für Dachspitzen, Giebel und Türme.
Sheet-iron strap hinges for doors, gates and shutters, each nail hole cut through.
Langbänder aus Flacheisen für Türen, Tore und Läden, jedes Nagelloch durchgehend.
Forged scrollwork from round bar, for doors and walls.
Geschmiedete Ranken aus Rundeisen für Türen und Wände.

name: Fretwork bracket
Laubsägekonsole
pieces.note: Traced from the reference with trace_profile.py and built with build_fretwork.py; a 2.5 cm board with a 3.5 cm upright. Width of 60 cm assumed.

name: Weather vane with monogram
Wetterfahne mit Monogramm
pieces.note: Flag traced (8 mm sheet); rod, stem, collar and sleeves turned from the measured profile; fleur-de-lis finial traced and shaped as a forged height field with a spine. 1 px = 1 mm, so 1.43 m tall. Pivot at the rod's tip.

name: Strap hinge with fan-leaf end
Langband mit Blattfächer
pieces.note: Traced (outline and every nail hole) and built as 6 mm sheet iron with build_ironwork.py --mode flat; 70 cm long assumed. Pivot at the hinge end, centred.

name: Strap hinge with scrolls
Langband mit Voluten
pieces.note: Traced (outline and every nail hole) and built as 6 mm sheet iron with build_ironwork.py --mode flat; 70 cm long assumed. Pivot at the hinge end, centred.

name: Strap hinge with crescent
Langband mit Halbmond
pieces.note: Traced (outline and every nail hole) and built as 6 mm sheet iron with build_ironwork.py --mode flat; 70 cm long assumed. Pivot at the hinge end, centred.

name: Strap hinge with curled tee
Langband mit gerolltem Kreuz
pieces.note: Traced (outline and every nail hole) and built as 6 mm sheet iron with build_ironwork.py --mode flat; 70 cm long assumed. Pivot at the hinge end, centred.

name: Strap hinge with fleur-de-lis
Langband mit Lilie
pieces.note: Traced (outline and every nail hole) and built as 6 mm sheet iron with build_ironwork.py --mode flat; 70 cm long assumed. Pivot at the hinge end, centred.

name: Forged scroll ornament
Geschmiedetes Rankenornament
pieces.note: Traced and built as half-round bar on a flat back with build_ironwork.py --mode forged; 50 cm tall assumed. Pivot at the wall plate.

name: Barley-twist baluster
Baluster mit Kordeldrehung
pieces.note: Turned from the profile measured row by row; rope twist (5 beads), twisted bulb (10), reeded urn (18) and a 12-leaf collar carved onto the turned surface; gilt rings as a second material (M_TW_Brass). 90 cm tall assumed. The band's small gilt ornaments are left out.

name: Stone vase baluster
Steinbaluster in Vasenform
pieces.note: Turned from the profile measured row by row (build_lathe.py), every moulding kept: cove and fillet under the cap, two fillet-and-torus rings, the vase belly, scotia and torus at the foot; square cap, plate and plinth with small bevels. 80 cm tall assumed. The granite speckle is texture.
